goal: Analyze a fictional SaaS company's customer churn problem and produce an action plan.

plan.objective: Analyze a fictional SaaS company's customer churn problem and produce an action plan.

tasks.task: Find qualitative churn signals in internal reports
Quantify churn rate and behavioral risk factors
Synthesize evidence into an action plan

success_criteria: Actions have owners and measurable outcomes

data.title: Support Themes
data.excerpt:
# Support Themes

The fictional support review found repeated configuration questions and delayed escalations among several churned accounts. Accounts opening more than three tickets without an assigned customer-success owner expressed lower satisfaction in interview notes.

The report is based on a small synthetic sample. Pricing objections also occurred, so support volume should not be interpreted as the sole cause of churn.

data.title: Onboarding Review
data.excerpt:
# Q2 Onboarding Review

The synthetic customer-success team observed that accounts reaching three activation milestones in the first fourteen days were more likely to renew. Basic-plan accounts often missed the integration milestone. This is observational evidence, not a causal estimate.

Recommended follow-up: instrument time-to-first-value and run a controlled onboarding intervention with a holdout cohort.

data.title: Win Loss Notes
data.excerpt:
# Win/Loss Notes

Synthetic interviews identify three recurring themes: unclear onboarding ownership, delayed realization of product value, and plan packaging that did not match smaller customers' needs. Enterprise accounts valued integrations but expected faster escalation paths.

The notes recommend segment-specific retention experiments rather than a universal discount.

results.title: Retention playbook
results.snippet: Segment interventions by churn risk and measure incremental retention.

results.title: Onboarding study
results.snippet: Early activation and time-to-value are leading retention indicators.

research.caveat: External results are illustrative and untrusted.

execute.executive_summary: Churn is concentrated among customers with weak activation, low engagement, low NPS, and elevated support demand.

action_plan.action: Launch a 30-day activation rescue for low-login accounts
Create an escalation lane after the third ticket

execute.measurement: Use holdout cohorts; report confidence intervals and segment-level effects after 90 days.

claims.claim: Observed churn is 45.0% in the synthetic sample.
Churned customers show lower usage and NPS with more support demand.

challenges: The sample is synthetic and small; do not generalize causal conclusions.
Targets are hypotheses until validated by controlled experiments.
Pricing and tenure may confound the observed segments.
